requirements.text: DocBook is the root element of book documents
a TitledElement of DocBook has one title
Sect1 is a section of DocBook
Para is a paragraph of DocBook that has a content
a DocBook has one to many Book that serves as books
a Book has one to many Article that serves as articles
an Article of DocBook has one to many Sect1 that serves as sections
Sect1 has one to many para that serves as paras
